key.name: socket-path
key.description: Unix domain socket the desktop application uses to reach the AgentOS core service. Change this only when the service was configured with a different core.socket_path.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Last window width in logical pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Last window height in logical pixels.

key.name: last-view
key.description: View shown when the window opens: chat, tasks, system, approvals, activity, or settings.

key.name: confirm-before-approving
key.description: When enabled, granting an approval asks for confirmation showing the exact operation, target, and parameters. Recommended: an approval is bound to precisely those facts.
